info.title: Web Intelligence Platform
info.description: Universal Intelligence Platform. Auth: Bearer login token (POST /api/v1/auth/login) or X-API-Key header with scopes. Mutating routes return 401 without credentials when REQUIRE_AUTH=1, 403 when role/scopes lack the action. All errors are JSON.

post.description:
Evidence-first chat: optional spec.evidence is sanitized + wrapped as
untrusted DATA; every call is usage/cost-tracked; fallback chain on error.

Delete aged operational rows per policy. Audited. Canonical
entities/evidence are never touched unless explicitly listed.

get.description:
Backend-driven catalog for the Add-Provider flow (single source of
truth; the UI renders from this, nothing is duplicated in frontend).

post.description:
Live test of a SAVED provider: decrypt server-side, real connect +
auth + discovery + model verify. Structured result, key never returned.

Live test of an UNSAVED configuration (Add flow): nothing persisted,
key used once server-side and discarded. Same structured result.
Model discovery for an unsaved configuration (nothing persisted).
Model discovery for a saved provider (key decrypted server-side).

Real connection test: strategy decision + live direct fetch attempt.
Updates the persisted target profile (attempts/latency/preferred).

get.description: Scan/job detail: status, attempts, extracted prices, changes, alerts, errors.

post.description:
Execute the full pipeline inline: fetch → validate → normalize →
change-detect → alerts. BROWSER/proxy legs stay deferred to workers.
Go collector / Python worker result ingestion (contracts/results/result.json).
Run one schedule immediately: creates a collection job from it.

Execute due schedules: creates collection jobs. Called by systemd
worker or cron; also powers the UI 'Run scheduler' button.

get.description: Dead-letter queue depth (Redis when available, else empty — honest).

post.description: Regenerate: rebuild the same report kind/project from current data.

get.description:
Human-in-the-loop queue: REVIEW entities, UNVERIFIED/CONFLICTED claims,
low-confidence findings. Approve/reject via entity ops + claim verify.
Rich explorer: overview, timeline, relationships, events, changes, evidence.

post.description:
Generate evidence-grounded analysis via AI provider chain.
Without credentials returns an honest error; never fake analysis.

get.description: Answer 'where did this come from?': finding -> evidence -> sources/jobs.

post.description:
Run a watchlist against recent prices/articles/events NOW.
Matches create alerts (cooldown-guarded).

Idempotent retry: same event replays to the same idempotency keys,
returning the ORIGINAL run when nothing new executes.
